statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study, CPT 93229, was ordered.
The service was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events.
Diagnosis code I48.0 (paroxysmal atrial fibrillation) was submitted.
Diagnosis code I34.0 (nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency) was submitted.
Diagnosis code I49.5 (sick sinus syndrome) was submitted.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197.
The submitted materials do not align with the records currently maintained in the insurer's system.
